choices.label: Take it
choices.sub: Gain a relic. Gain a Hex.

cursedIdol.name: The Cursed Idol
cursedIdol.text: A jade idol sits on a plinth of skulls, radiating a soft warmth. It has clearly been left here for a reason.

emberFountain.name: Fountain of Embers
emberFountain.text: Liquid light pools in a cracked basin, throwing sparks that do not burn. It smells of summer and old victories.

choices.label: Trade
choices.sub: Lose 8 Max HP. Gain a relic.

fleshTrader.name: The Flesh Trader
fleshTrader.text: "Vitality is a currency," purrs a thing wearing a merchant's coat. "And you look flush with it." Long fingers open to reveal a relic.

forge.name: The Forgotten Forge
forge.text: An anvil of black star-metal, still warm. Hammers hang in racks, waiting for hands that died an age ago.

choices.label: Pray
choices.sub: Remove a card from your deck.

forgottenShrine.name: Forgotten Shrine
forgottenShrine.text: A moss-eaten shrine hums with old power. Offerings of bone and silver litter its base. Something watches from inside the stone.

roll.text: The bones land in your favour. You claim 110 gold.
The bones rattle against you. The wager is lost.

gambler.name: The Bone Gambler
gambler.text: A grinning figure rattles a cup of knuckle-bones. "One throw, stranger. Fortune loves the reckless."

choices.label: Study
choices.sub: Choose 1 of 5 cards to add to your deck.

library.name: The Drowned Library
library.text: Shelves of waterlogged grimoires stretch into the dark. Most are pulp — but a few pages still glow faintly.

choices.label: Reflect
choices.sub: Duplicate a card in your deck.

choices.label: Shatter it
choices.sub: Lose 6 HP. Remove a card from your deck.

mirror.name: The Silvered Mirror
mirror.text: A tall mirror stands in the rubble, unbroken. Your reflection moves half a breath behind you — and it is smiling.

choices.label: Scavenge
choices.sub: Gain 45 gold and a random potion.

ruinedCamp.name: Ruined Camp
ruinedCamp.text: A campfire, still smoldering. Bedrolls, torn. Whoever slept here left in a hurry — and left their packs behind.

choices.label: Open it
choices.sub: It might hold a relic... or teeth.

voidChest.name: Humming Chest
voidChest.text: A black iron chest sits alone in the gloom, humming a note you feel in your teeth. Its lock is already broken.

choices.label: Aid him
choices.sub: Lose 8 HP. He rewards you with a relic.

woundedKnight.name: The Wounded Knight
woundedKnight.text: A knight slumps against a shattered pillar, breath rattling behind a crushed visor. One gauntlet clutches a relic; the other beckons you closer.

ashfall.name: Ashfall
ashfall.text: Ash chokes every fire: enemies begin combat with 2 Smolder, but their blows leave 1 Smolder on you.

eighthOmen.name: The Eighth Omen
eighthOmen.text: Every lesser battle bears a title. The broken words follow every waystone.

emberWind.name: Ember Wind
emberWind.text: Sparks ride the wind into your lantern: begin each combat with 2 Embers, but draw 4 cards instead of 5.

heavyAir.name: Heavy Air
heavyAir.text: The air holds light like water: all Ward gained is increased by a quarter — yours and theirs.

hungryDark.name: The Hungry Dark
hungryDark.text: The dark eats coin but sharpens choice: shop prices are a quarter higher, and card rewards offer 1 more choice.

longNight.name: The Long Night
longNight.text: The road stretches on: enemies carry 12% more life, but every victory pays 40% more gold.

thinGlass.name: Thin Glass
thinGlass.text: Tonight all glass runs thin: every facet gauge is 1 smaller, but enemy blows strike 2 harder.

waningMoon.name: Waning Moon
waningMoon.text: The moon spends her last light on you: your first card each turn costs 1 less, but rest sites heal only 20%.

player.blurb: Glass honed to a killing edge. Strikes, shatters, and turns broken facets into fuel — a blade that cuts a road through any night.
player.name: The Duskblade

eighthOmen.inscription: Reach dawn beneath the Eighth Omen.
eighthOmen.name: The Eighth Omen
eighthOmen.resolved: THE EIGHTH OMEN WAS NEVER AN OMEN. IT WAS THE SHADOW OF A DOOR.

hollowLamplighter.inscription: Pay the Hollow Lamplighter five prices along the Unlit Way.

meetings.accepted: The next three embers belong to the hollow lantern.
meetings.ask: Your lantern is noisy. Give me the next three embers it catches.
meetings.cannot: Promise the embers now. The lantern will pay before you do.
meetings.paid: Six panes were carried away from a window no wall could hold.

meetings.ask: Gold remembers every hand. Let one hundred and sixty pieces forget yours.
meetings.cannot: Your purse is warm, but not warm enough.
meetings.paid: The Pale Ones watch the paths that point beyond the crown.

meetings.ask: The road counts the vessel. Give me twelve measures of yours.
meetings.cannot: I will not hollow you below thirty. Return with a larger vessel.
meetings.paid: Your forebears died standing, facing east.

meetings.ask: The Keeper gave you a boon. Give me the gift, not the gratitude.
meetings.cannot: You have spent the gift already. Bring me one that is still yours.
meetings.paid: The empty lantern is the token that purchases an audience with the mask.

meetings.ask: Last price: leave this lantern with one heartbeat. The rest belongs to the dark.
meetings.cannot: One heartbeat is enough. Refusal is the only poverty left.
meetings.paid: Light the panes. The door will know you.

hollowLamplighter.name: The Hollow Lamplighter

ownShade.final: We were never walking to be free. We were carrying light to the lock.
fragments: I remember the stone. You walked away before I stopped calling.
You have left a shape behind. The road has learned to keep us.
I have seen it. Beyond the Sovereign there is no dawn — only a door pretending to be one.
ownShade.inscription: Defeat the self that still remembers the road. Three shades must go out.
ownShade.name: Your Own Shade

paleOnes.huntInscription: Defeat three pale foes and follow the cold motes they leave behind.
paleOnes.inscription: Hunt the Pale Ones. Gather nine motes from glass that has forgotten colour.
paleOnes.name: The Pale Ones
progress: The first pale mote chills the lantern.

unreadablePage.inscription: Win five dawns carrying the Unreadable Page.
unreadablePage.name: The Unreadable Page
pages: FIRST PAGE — Six panes were cut from one fire, then scattered before the first Vigil.
SECOND PAGE — Pale figures carried the shards west, so the thing beyond the door could not follow.
THIRD PAGE — A pilgrim died standing. Where he stopped, the road did not.
FOURTH PAGE — The Sovereign took an empty lantern and wore a king's shape over the lock.
FIFTH PAGE — The Rose Window is a map, not a memorial. Light it, then look beyond the crown.

usurper.bought: Now the throne knows what you carry.
usurper.death: The mask is broken. Look beyond the crown.
usurper.inscription: Carry the lantern with no flame to the sealed door, and unmask the Usurper.
usurper.itemText: Cold glass. No wick. The merchant will not say who left it.
usurper.name: The Usurper
usurper.poor: Cold goods, warm price. Come back carrying a dawn's worth of gold.

whispers: There is a colour the road refuses to name.
A pale hand has touched the dark side of the glass.
Six spaces wait where no window stands.
The dead walk twice: once in flesh, once in memory.
A lantern without flame is still a key.
Count the panes that do not catch the dawn.
A page can be read only after it survives the dawn.
The eighth sign is not written among the seven.
The gaunt keeper remembers the road you did not take.
Pale motes gather like frost around a hidden seam.
Your monument does not always lie down.
The merchant keeps one cold thing beneath the counter.
Broken glyphs are the shadow of a complete sentence.
Five pages make a chapter; five prices make a confession.
Three deaths will teach your shade to speak plainly.
The Vigil has a window, though no wall holds it.
Each shard lights one pane of the Rose Window.
The Pale Ones are not hunting you. They are pointing east.
The Sovereign is a mask worn before the last door.
When six panes burn, look beyond the crown.
There is a sealed door beyond the crown.
Its inscription has waited longer than the Vigil.
Bring six shards to the Rose Window.
The pilgrimage continues.
